title: Try it once, but expect little
text: Selected the mostly sweets box. With both boxes half of the contents were sour. First box was good even though I ended up throwing out 2 flavors because they were too sour. Second box 4 out of 6 containers were melted. Will not go on for a third box. I recommend sticking to the candy shops at a mall. This is a bust and waste of money if most arrive melted or not what you ordered.
label: negative
